title: Illuminating Lights
statementMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dea999c09a9a2fb9be684880f0ab3aee3f216488.png)

You are given the positions of a collection of lights in the plane. At time 00 they are all simultaneously activated, and at time T𝑇 each light illuminates an axis-aligned square of side length 2T2𝑇 centered on itself. You must decide whether there is a time T>0𝑇>0 when the illuminated area is a rectangle.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t𝑡 (1≤t≤2⋅1051≤𝑡≤2⋅105). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains an integer n𝑛 (1≤n≤2⋅1051≤𝑛≤2⋅105) — the number of lights.

Each of the next n𝑛 lines of each test case contains two integers xi𝑥𝑖 and yi𝑦𝑖 (−109≤xi,yi≤109−109≤𝑥𝑖,𝑦𝑖≤109) — the coordinates of the i𝑖-th light. The positions of the lights are guaranteed to be distinct.

It is guaranteed that the sum of n𝑛 over all test cases does not exceed 2⋅1052⋅105.

## Output

For each test case, print `YES` if the illuminated area is at some point a rectangle, and `NO` otherwise.

You can output `YES` and `NO` in any case (for example, `yES`, `yes`, and `Yes` will be accepted).

## Note

In the second test case, which is shown in the statement, it can be shown that regardless of how much time passes, the illuminated area will never be a rectangle.
statementZhMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dea999c09a9a2fb9be684880f0ab3aee3f216488.png)

给定平面上一组灯的位置。在时刻 0，所有灯同时开启；在时刻 T，每盏灯照亮以自身为中心、边长为 2T、各边平行于坐标轴的正方形区域。你需要判断，是否存在某个时刻 T>0，使得被照亮的区域是一个矩形。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例数 t（1≤t≤2⋅10⁵）。接下来是各组测试用例的描述。

每组测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 n（1≤n≤2⋅10⁵），表示灯的数量。

接下来的 n 行，每行包含两个整数 xi 和 yi（−10⁹≤xi,yi≤10⁹），表示第 i 盏灯的坐标。保证所有灯的位置互不相同。

保证所有测试用例的 n 之和不超过 2⋅10⁵。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试用例，如果被照亮的区域在某个时刻是一个矩形，输出 `YES`，否则输出 `NO`。

输出 `YES` 和 `NO` 时可以使用任意大小写形式（例如，`yES`、`yes` 和 `Yes` 都会被接受）。

## 说明

第二组测试用例如题面中的图所示。可以证明，无论经过多长时间，被照亮的区域都不会成为一个矩形。
